Hi Luke — thanks for the sample and the prompt questions. Short answers up front: portal preferred; email fallback allowed for low-volume/new vendors; we do require a few mandatory fields. Details below.

Portal vs email:
- Preferred path: Redwood Vendor Portal (link below) — immediate acknowledgements, automated PO matching, and faster payment processing.
- Email fallback: ap-invoices@redwood.com for vendors that cannot access the portal during onboarding. Use subject token: Brightwell-Invoice-<YYYYMMDD>-<invoice#>.

Minimum required fields (either CSV columns or clearly labeled on PDF):
- Redwood PO number (exact match)
- Billing entity and Redwood entity code (if present on PO)
- Invoice date and invoice number
- Line-level description, quantity, unit price, tax, line total
- Invoice total and currency

Multiple PO numbers: allowed on one invoice, but each PO must be line-mapped. If you include multiple POs on a single invoice, please ensure each line row contains a PO column and include a PO subtotal row or a separate PO-total section.

Onboarding form: I attached the vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf — please complete the banking/remittance and remit-to info and return it when convenient. That helps us ensure payments route to the correct ledger.

If the portal is blocked by your IT (SSO), please send a short note back and we will enable the email fallback and provide the CSV template. Looping in Vanessa (vendor onboarding) for any setup questions.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Strategic Vendors | Redwood Inference

Hi Luke — Jordan on Billing. Thanks for the sample CSV and for flagging the SSO issue. We can accept emailed invoices as an interim process while onboarding is completed. Please follow the instructions below to avoid delays.

Destination and subject:
- Send to: ap-invoices@redwood.com (single mailbox)
- Subject must start with: Brightwell-Invoice-<YYYYMMDD>-<invoice#>

CSV template (attached: redwood_csv_template.csv). Required columns (case-insensitive):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- vendor_name
- remittance_entity_code
- redwood_po_number
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price (decimal)
- line_tax
- line_total
- currency

Rules for multiple POs on a single invoice:
- You may include multiple PO numbers on separate rows (preferred approach: include a redwood_po_number column per line).
- If you emit one row per PO (summary row), add a column invoice_line_type with value PO_TOTAL and include PO-level totals; our matching requires either line-level PO mapping or a clear PO total row.

Other notes:
- Remittance: include the remittance_entity_code (found on the onboarding form) so the payment posts to the correct ledger.
- Net terms: Net 45 is acceptable for this arrangement; note payment date will be calculated from receipt of a clean invoice.
- Please avoid password-protected attachments in the email body.

We attached our CSV template and will provision temporary email fallback for you. Once your SSO issue is resolved, we will re-route you to the portal and discontinue the fallback. Please return the completed vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf with a vendor remittance contact.

If you want, Vanessa can set a short Zoom (15 min) to walk through the template and where to place PO subtotals.

Thanks — looping back to Vanessa for scheduling.

Jordan Blake
Billing Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
